static_traits.name: Lin Yao
static_traits.family_status: 与配偶和孩子同住，在山中有度假屋
static_traits.social_status: 配偶支持但not yet充分了解其恐惧强度；因not愿驾驶导致Family relationships出现紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without以往心理治疗史；此前not yet出现过类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高、逻辑性强；态度积极；在谈及驾驶时出现Significant anxiety并描述心悸、胸闷、头晕等生理反应

basic_info.main_problem: 对驾驶SUV时发生事故并立即Death的强烈恐惧，购车后数月出现并逐渐升级，导致尽量Avoids driving。
basic_info.core_demands: I become aware that this fear is becoming a major obstacle to my daily life and responsibilities, so I seek counseling; I hope to regain a sense of control over the fear and restore independence.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If driving a large and powerful vehicle on the highway, once something happens it would be fatal
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid highways, pulls over when necessary, reduces the number of drives
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我马上会失控撞车，可能当场Death

special_situations.event: 在拥堵路况或繁忙交通中驾驶
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在复杂路况中更容易发生事故，一旦发生我将without法应对
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避高峰期和复杂路段，减少出行
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Traffic is so complicated; an accident will soon happen to me

special_situations.event: Holding the SUV steering wheel, feeling the vehicle's size and power
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: The bigger and more powerful the vehicle, the harder it is for me to control; mistakes would have serious consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Drives tensely and stiffly, uses breathing and distraction techniques to relieve it, but still tends to avoid
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这车太大太有力，我根本控制not住

special_situations.event: 听闻或想到类似SUV发生事故的消息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: This type of vehicle is more dangerous; I am also very likely to have the same accident
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reinforcement对驾驶的回避、将危险信息作为not驾驶的理由
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 驾驶SUV就是更容易出事故

core_conflict.wish: Longs for safety and controllability, to be able to drive with peace of mind and maintain life independence
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失去控制并发生致命事故
defense_goal: 通过Avoids driving来降低危险感与Anxiety，维持主观安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 脆弱、容易失控的驾驶者
object_relations.object_representation: 配偶是支持者但not yet充分了解其恐惧的旁观者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the source of the fear or needing to explain why one fears driving SUVs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to attribute fear entirely to the vehicle's objective size and power, regarding it as the main source of danger
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use客观、理性的语句强调车辆的“大与有力”，淡化主观感受；语气平稳、条理化解释风险，减少情感曝光。

manifestations: 驾驶SUV时强烈预想发生致命事故
在高速与繁忙路况中更强烈的Death恐惧
伴随心悸、胸闷、头晕等身体反应

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: not yet向配偶充分表达恐惧的强度与影响，选择独自承受
Prefers self-regulation (breathing, distraction) over proactively seeking external support

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse and family resources
多数驾驶经历实际安全without事故的客观证据
Positive attitude, willing to try gradual practice to rebuild a sense of control
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知模式
对大型车辆的控制谬误（自认为without法掌控）
Avoids driving导致功能受限并维持恐惧
not yet向家人充分表达恐惧强度，难以获得有效支持

antecedent: 高速公路与繁忙交通情境
听闻类似车辆事故信息
target_behavior.core_reason: 对车辆尺寸与动力的危险感受引发灾难化与预测not yet来的思维，担心失控并发生致命事故
target_behavior.function: Avoids fear and subjective danger, gains immediate security
target_behavior.consequence: 日常活动与独立性受限；Family relationships出现紧张

target_behavior.behavior: 驾驶时出现强烈Anxiety/恐慌反应（心悸、胸闷、头晕、颤抖）
antecedent: 在高速或拥堵路况驾驶SUV时
The automatic thought 'I will lose control and have a fatal accident' appears
target_behavior.core_reason: Emotional reasoning and catastrophizing amplify the subjective experience of danger, forming a conditioned physiological stress response
target_behavior.function: Prompts stopping or reducing driving through physiological reactions to avoid perceived danger
target_behavior.consequence: 需要靠边停车或中断驾驶，进一步Reinforcement回避循环
